rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a person who commits murder.

example.english: The police finally caught that murderer.
example.traditional: 警方終於捉到嗰個兇手喇。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zung1 jyu1 zuk1 dou2 go2 go3 hung1 sau2 laa3

rows.note: A speaker uses this more explicitly when stressing that the person is legally or factually a murderer.

example.english: The court ruled that he was a murderer.
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 coi4 ding6 keoi5 hai6 saat3 jan4 faan6

rows.note: This is used for the hitman or professional killer slice of the meaning rather than for every murderer.

example.english: That murderer is a hitman who kills people for hire.
example.traditional: 嗰個殺手專門替人殺人。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 saat3 sau2 zyun1 mun4 tai3 jan4 saat3 jan4
